calculation_methodology: Offline batch lexical analysis and structural token extraction across all N=134,850 legitimate URLs (label=1) in PhiUSIIL. Features extracted using the 18-feature lexical pipeline aligned with the production Random Forest classifier. Slashes, query parameters, path segments, and special character counts were evaluated with zero network calls.

feature_definitions.URLLength: Total character count of the URL string (normalized protocol length)
feature_definitions.DomainLength: Total length of the domain/hostname component
feature_definitions.IsDomainIP: Whether the domain host is a direct IP address (1 = Yes, 0 = No)
feature_definitions.TLDLength: Length of the Top-Level Domain suffix (e.g., com=3, org=3, uk=2)
feature_definitions.NoOfSubDomain: Number of subdomain levels in the domain
feature_definitions.HasObfuscation: Presence of hex/percent encoding in the URL (1 = Yes, 0 = No)
feature_definitions.NoOfObfuscatedChar: Total count of characters within hex encodings (%xx)
feature_definitions.ObfuscationRatio: Ratio of obfuscated characters to URL length
feature_definitions.NoOfLettersInURL: Total count of alphabetic letters in the URL body
feature_definitions.LetterRatioInURL: Ratio of alphabetic letters to total URL length
feature_definitions.NoOfDegitsInURL: Total count of numeric digits [0-9] in the URL
feature_definitions.DegitRatioInURL: Ratio of numeric digits to total URL length
feature_definitions.NoOfEqualsInURL: Count of '=' characters (typical in query parameters)
feature_definitions.SpacialCharRatioInURL: Ratio of special characters to total URL length
feature_definitions.IsHTTPS: Whether HTTPS protocol is active (1 = Secure HTTPS, 0 = Insecure HTTP)
